questions.question: What did Miriam and Aaron criticize Moses about?

answers.text: The way he led them out

questions.question: When the LORD spoke to Miriam and Aaron about Moses, He said Moses was faithful in all His house. True or false?
After Miriam was struck with leprosy for speaking against Moses, what did Moses do?

answers.text: Cried out to God to heal her
Told Aaron to pray for her instead
Asked the elders to decide for him
